passages.provision_quote: Any large online platform shall develop and implement procedures for the use of state-of-the-art techniques to identify and remove materially deceptive content if all of the following conditions are met:
passages.note: The same chapter also requires platforms to label other deceptive content outside the removal window, so it does not exclude the adjacent rung.

rows.reasoning: AB 2655 (2023-2024), authored by Berman and signed into law, requires large online platforms to 'identify and remove materially deceptive content' tied to elections within specified periods, matching rung 1's 'legally require platforms to remove false information'; but the same chapter also requires platforms to label materially deceptive content that falls outside that removal window, matching rung 2's 'require platforms to label false content, rather than remove it'. Because the instrument implements both mechanisms rather than excluding the adjacent rung, it establishes only the direction toward mandatory platform obligations, not a single rung.
